title: Office Hours before the Test
story: The biology test was on Wednesday. Amir did not understand the chapter on cells. He wrote three questions in his notebook and went to office hours on Monday. Teacher Rahman sat with him at a side table. She asked Amir to explain the chapter in his own words. He stopped at the part about plant cells. The teacher drew a simple picture and labelled the wall, the centre, and the green parts. Amir copied it and answered his own questions aloud. Teacher Rahman told him to teach the picture to a friend that night. Amir met Noor in the common room and explained it. Amir left feeling ready.
